playthrough_notes: Two playthroughs / chapter replay approach: Playthrough 1 is a clean no-passwords run covering 51 achievements without purchasing grape or clover juice in Chapter 2, culminating in One-Course Veggie Tale (98092). Playthrough 2 is a post-game Chapter 2 replay using password to purchase the juices and collect all items for Saladoria's Cornucopia (98049), safely avoiding the mutual exclusion / lockout conflict.
settings_notes: Play on standard NES emulator settings with standard controls. Rock-Paper-Scissors direction controls: Up = Rock, Left = Scissors, Right = Paper. Look-Away controls: Up = Up, Down = Down, Left = Left, Right = Right.

ponr.label: Entering Saladoria Town Gate
ponr.warning: Passing through the gate into Saladoria ends Chapter 1 and permanently drops unnecessary items.

ponr.label: Entering Saladoria Bookshop
ponr.warning: Exiting the bookshop triggers your arrest and immediately ends Chapter 2.

ponr.label: Escaping Police Station with Lantern
ponr.warning: Blending into the guards with the lantern ends Chapter 3 permanently.

ponr.label: Talking to Mr. Leek outside Sacred Tree
ponr.warning: Talking to Mr. Leek after reclaiming the Yam Medallion triggers the journey to Resistance Base and ends Chapter 4.

ponr.label: Exiting Resistance Base for Peanut Village
ponr.warning: Leaving the base to Peanut Village permanently closes Chapter 5.

ponr.label: Boarding the Dice-O-Matic Robot
ponr.warning: Starting the Dice-O-Matic robot battle permanently leaves Peanut Plateau and ends Chapter 6.

ponr.label: Entering the Secret Underground Passage
ponr.warning: Digging and entering the secret passage ends Chapter 7 and transitions to Minister's Castle.

ponr.label: Confronting Minister Pumpkin in his Chambers
ponr.warning: Entering Minister Pumpkin's chamber triggers the boss fight and subsequent castle escape, ending Chapter 8.

ponr.label: Engaging Junior Pumpkin Finale
ponr.warning: Defeating Junior Pumpkin triggers the ending sequence and final victory.

chapters.title: Salad Kingdom Outskirts & The Rescue of Percy
chapters.notes: Do not miss the Diospyros command before meeting Percy, and collect all 5 items before entering the gate.

chapters.title: Saladoria City Investigation & The Arrest
chapters.notes: On Run 1: DO NOT buy juices. Catch Octoberry on Main Street for coin 98045. On Run 2: Buy juices for 98049.

chapters.title: Police Station Incarceration & Escape
chapters.notes: Trigger the alarm button outside cell for 98053 before finishing the escape.

chapters.title: Spinach Heights, Parsley Forest Maze & Saladron
chapters.notes: Flawless Farmie (Right then Down), all maze items, flawless Saladron (Left only), and receive Grape Juice from Mr. Leek.

chapters.title: The Resistance Headquarters
chapters.notes: Trade grape juice to Grapy for clover juice, and equip both Nut Bomb and Black Bean in arms room.

chapters.title: Peanut Village, Bananda's Cave & The Dice-O-Matic
chapters.notes: Collect all 5 cave coin pouches, decipher Bee statue with Wordbook, collect all 12 items, defeat War Melons with Down Right Right Left.

chapters.title: Sopville Infiltration & Secret Passage
chapters.notes: Feed bread to Yam and juice to Asparagus, collect all 9 chapter items including shovel and bar key.

chapters.title: Minister's Castle, Monster Maze & Princess Tomato
chapters.notes: Defeat Mama Monster in maze dead end, collect all 12 items, execute 8-move pattern against Minister Pumpkin.

chapters.title: Courtyard Climax & Salad Kingdom Liberation
chapters.notes: Defeat Junior Pumpkin with Nut Bomb and win game without passwords for One-Course Veggie Tale.
